headline: Dad Discovers His Anonymous Liver Donor Through Social Media
meta_description: A father battling stage 4 colorectal cancer discovers the identity of his anonymous liver donor through an unexpected social media connection.
summary_short: After receiving a life-saving liver transplant, a father learned who his anonymous donor was through a chance social media post while facing stage 4 colorectal cancer.
body:
A father who received a liver transplant has discovered the identity of his anonymous donor through a social media post—a rare and moving connection that emerged just as he faced a new health crisis.

The discovery came during an especially vulnerable time: after his stage 4 colorectal cancer diagnosis. Rather than the typical experience of never knowing who gave them a second chance at life, this man found himself able to connect with and thank the person behind his transplant.

Stories like this highlight both the profound impact of organ donation and the unexpected ways modern technology can bridge deeply personal human connections. The encounter speaks to the gratitude that transplant recipients carry, and the lasting bonds that can form between donors and those they've saved.
quick_facts: Man discovered his anonymous liver donor through social media
Discovery happened after stage 4 colorectal cancer diagnosis
